title: TrustGuard: GNN-based Robust and Explainable Trust Evaluation with Dynamicity Support
reasoning: The paper focuses on 'trust evaluation' in a technical context within digital systems and social networks, involving the analysis of ratings and interactions. While trust can have ethical implications, the paper treats it as a computational problem, defining numerical trust levels and evaluating model performance (accuracy, robustness, explainability) on given datasets. It does not evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical principles from a philosophical standpoint.
